drafts.reddit_title: Coordinating Product Marketing And Sales Teams During B2B Software Launches
drafts.reddit_body:
Many software launches suffer because product marketing, sales, and leadership teams operate from separate internal plans. Buyers often encounter conflicting messages between the public website and direct sales conversations. Standardizing the launch process from initial market research to the 90-day review helps align every department. Practitioners facing similar coordination challenges might find useful templates and module outlines within the published guide.

https://archanacontent.github.io/b2b-saas/
